role: Manual mutation-testing harness (not in make ci or any workflow; ci.yml only comments on it) that applies 125 targeted source mutations one at a time, requiring the named XCTest class to go red for each. All 125 anchors apply and all named suite classes exist at 8d32097 (checked on a scratch copy).
toplevel: set -uo pipefail; cd to repo root; sources preflight. DEST from select_simulator_destination.sh (exit 70 if empty). gate_mktemp_dir (fails on GNU mktemp), then acquire lock and set trap restore_all/rm/release. Runs `mutate` for each case (lines 145-975; anchors and suite classes verified to exist at 8d32097 — two named suites (AutoPauseDetectorTests, TrackBackupWatermarkTests) are classes inside WorkoutTickStateTests.swift). Prints totals; exits 1 if any FAIL or SKIP (skips explicitly treated as unverified). A build failure caused by the mutation itself counts as 'caught' (see mutate flag); e.g. import_cadence_divides_by_zero_window substitutes `sample.count`, a member HealthSampleWindow does not have (HealthSampleWindow.swift:15-23), so that case can only ever 'pass' via a compile error. The comment at 167-168 about the encrypted-write branch sits above the unrelated import_offset_unguarded case; the encryption mutation is at line 337.

units.does: Copies file $1 into the backup dir ('/'->'_' name) and adds it to TOUCHED.
Copies each TOUCHED file's backup back over it and clears TOUCHED.
units.entry: also called from the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap

branches.effect: skip; otherwise cp (a missing backup makes cp fail silently, file left as is)

units.does: Runs `xcodebuild test -only-testing:<suite> -parallel-testing-enabled NO` into run.log; returns 0 on success, 2 if the log has BUILD/TEST BUILD FAILED or 'error: Building|Failed to' or contains no 'Test Suite'/'Test Case' line, else 1.

branches.cond: build-failure marker or no test ran

units.does: Runs one mutation: FILTER check; baseline run_suite (one retry on build failure); SKIP if baseline not green; backup, apply python mutation (SKIP on failure); run_suite again; restore; PASS if the post-mutation result is non-zero (1 or 2), FAIL 'SURVIVED' if 0.

branches.cond: FILTER set and not in name

branches.effect: PASS++ (includes code 2 = build failure); else FAIL++

flags.text: run_suite distinguishes build failure (2) from test failure (1) for the baseline, but after the mutation any non-zero code counts as 'caught'. A mutation that does not compile is reported PASS without any test asserting anything — e.g. import_cadence_divides_by_zero_window rewrites the guard to `sample.count >= 0`, and HealthSampleWindow has no `count` member, so that case passes on a compile error and HealthWorkoutImporterTests' coverage of the zero-window guard is never actually verified.
